Volvi a Medellin para empezar de cero. L: I came back to Medellin for a fresh start. Luna lends me her car for a delivery. But the envelope has my name on it... and tomorrow's date.
Vera encuentra una orden de desalojo fir: Vera finds an eviction order signed with my identity. Someone is selling the neighbourhood on behalf of people who never signed anything.
Luna: hay carros en las calles. TRIANGUL: Luna: there are cars on the streets. TRIANGLE to enter. The green one at the garage is on loan.
Consigue un carro y lleva el sobre al Ca: Get a car and take the envelope to Vera's cafe.
Abre el sobre digital: el archivo usa cu: Open the digital envelope: the file uses four digits.
Vuelve al refugio. Vera guardo una copia: Return to the safehouse. Vera kept a copy of the order.
La firma falsa aparece en el Archivo del: The forged signature appears in the Downtown Archive. I want to see the original. My sister Sara worked there before she disappeared.
No es solo tu firma. Hay cientos. En tod: It is not just your signature. There are hundreds. Every file mentions a fictional company: Prisma.
Habla con el archivista. Solo quedan ter: Talk to the archivist. Only disconnected terminals remain.
Reconecta el PC del archivo para consult: Reconnect the archive PC to check the signatures.
Reconstruye la secuencia del expediente: Reconstruct the sequence from Sara's file.
La imprenta puede conservar una copia fi: The print shop may have kept a paper copy.
Radio Ladera recibe mensajes de Sara mez: Radio Ladera receives messages from Sara mixed with interference. If I fix the link, we might hear her voice.
Sara: No confien en las pantallas. Miren: Sara: Don't trust the screens. Look at the city. The first key is where concrete learned to sing.
Sintoniza la voz escondida en Radio Lade: Tune into the hidden voice at Radio Ladera.
Sincroniza el sample en el estudio de hi: Synchronise the sample at the hip hop studio.
Busca el mural de la cancha en la Comuna: Find the court mural in Comuna 13.
Resuelve la clave del mural con sus cuat: Solve the mural's code using its four clues.
Taparon el mural durante la noche. Tiza: They covered the mural overnight. Tiza saved the sketches, but his backpack is on the other side of a guarded yard.
The sketch contains a map of blackouts. They are not random: they prepare entire streets to be emptied.
Cruza el patio sin tocar los haces de vi: Cross the yard without touching the surveillance beams.
Open the case containing the sketches.
Take the sketches to Laureles park.
Vera compara los apagones con los desalo: Vera compares the blackouts with the evictions.
Un comprador tiene la lista de los camio: A buyer has a list of Prisma's trucks. He will only negotiate with whoever wins his route. I don't like it, but we need that list.
Luna reconoce una matricula: es el camio: Luna recognises a licence plate: it belongs to the truck that collected the archive equipment the night Sara disappeared.
Luna prepara el recorrido. Consigue un c: Luna prepares the route. Get a sturdy car.
Completa seis controles urbanos antes de: Complete six city checkpoints before time runs out.
Vuelve al taller con la lista de matricu: Return to the garage with the list of licence plates.
El siguiente corte empieza esta noche. E: The next blackout starts tonight. The hospital is in the area. We can keep the lights on if we reach the substation in time.
El hospital sigue encendido. Prisma ya s: The hospital still has power. Prisma knows we are here. A message appears on my phone: Give back what isn't yours.
Lleva una bateria de emergencia al hospi: Take an emergency battery to the hospital.
Despista la persecucion y reduce la busq: Lose your pursuers and clear your wanted level.
Meet Vera. End of Chapter I.
La amenaza llevaba un ruido de fondo: fr: The threat had background noise: bus brakes and a bell. Mara thinks we can find where the message was recorded.
The sound comes from the North depot. A guard remembers Sara: she walked in willingly, with nobody forcing her.
Aisla la frecuencia de fondo del mensaje: Isolate the background frequency in the message.
Ask about Sara at the terminal.
Busca una senal en la antigua azotea de: Look for a signal on Sara's old rooftop.
Sara dejo una caja en su azotea. La cerr: Sara left a box on her rooftop. She locked it with games we invented as children. If I open it, I'll know why she never came home.
Una nota: Me infiltre en Prisma. Si desa: A note: I infiltrated Prisma. If I disappear, find the three nodes. Don't try to rescue me without evidence.
Decipher the code in Sara's diary.
Reconstruye las coordenadas de los tres: Reconstruct the coordinates of the three nodes.
Dona Luz conoce al tecnico del nodo occi: Dona Luz knows the western node technician. Her stall loses food during every blackout. Today we owe the neighbourhood a favour.
Luz entrega el plano del primer nodo. El: Luz hands over the first node's plan. The technician hid his notes on an old record so Prisma couldn't erase them.
Recoge las cajas refrigeradas del mercad: Collect the refrigerated boxes from the market.
Haz seis entregas por la ciudad sin agot: Make six city deliveries before time runs out.
Lee el patron grabado en el surco del vi: Read the pattern engraved in the record's groove.
El primer nodo esta detras de la cabina: The first node is behind the Cable car station. Tiza knows the way. His murals will guide us.
Conseguimos una tercera parte del regist: We recovered one third of the master record. Every eviction triggers a transfer to the same secret account.
Avoid the beams in the service corridor.
Conecta el nodo occidental al terminal a: Connect the western node to the isolated terminal.
Extract the first key from the record.
Un mensajero transporta los recibos orig: A courier carries the original receipts. They promised to protect his family, but now he wants out. We prepared a route for him.
El mensajero deja los recibos y se va. L: The courier leaves the receipts and goes. The signature authorising the purchases belongs to Cardenal, Prisma's director.
Pick up the courier in a car.
Lose the people following the courier.
Leave the courier at the hospital.
Los recibos bastan para denunciar las co: The receipts are enough to report the purchases, but someone leaks the complaint. Tonight they are coming for the print shop and its copies.
Salvamos los documentos. Mi nombre ya no: We saved the documents. Mine is no longer the only name on Prisma's list: all my friends are on it now.
Open the print shop storage room.
Take the documents to the lookout.
Vera decides to continue. End of Chapter II.
Por fin llama Sara. Esta viva. No puede: Sara finally calls. She is alive. She cannot leave yet: she found a plan to erase Prisma's debts and blame the neighbours.
Sara nos da una hora y una frecuencia. E: Sara gives us a time and a frequency. The river node holds the money routes, but opens only during the shift change.
Cruza el patio durante el cambio de guar: Cross the yard during the guard shift change.
Recoge la tarjeta que Sara dejo en la re: Collect the card Sara left at the gate.
La bodega parece abandonada. Por debajo: The warehouse looks abandoned. New cables run underneath it. An independent circuit protects the river record.
El dinero no sale de la ciudad. Regresa: The money never leaves the city. It returns as impossible loans to the same neighbourhoods they want to empty.
Copia las transferencias en el orden cor: Copy the transfers in the correct order.
Vera combines the first two keys.
Un vecino vio a Prisma mover un servidor: A neighbour saw Prisma move a server through San Juan. Tiza wants to photograph its label before they hide it.
La etiqueta muestra el destino: Torre Pr: The label shows the destination: Prisma Tower. The last node is inside their own headquarters.
Find the neighbour under the bridge.
Llega al contenedor sin activar la vigil: Reach the container without triggering surveillance.
Take the evidence to the print shop.
Necesitamos una invitacion a la galeria: We need an invitation to the gallery funding Prisma. Mara plays there tonight. I can help at the console and enter with her crew.
Entre dos canciones oimos a Cardenal: el: Between songs we hear Cardenal: the wipe is called Horizonte. It will run when they open the tower.
Take Mara and the equipment to the gallery.
Sara necesita que retiremos un carro de: Sara needs us to remove a Prisma car before they search its boot. She hid a copy of the Horizonte program inside.
Horizonte no solo borra archivos. Puede: Horizonte does not just erase files. It can shut down traffic lights, communications and water pumps to keep people from leaving.
Consigue un carro y lleva el respaldo al: Get a car and take the backup to the garage.
El rastreador alerta a los perseguidores: The tracker alerts the pursuers. Lose them.
The leak came from our safehouse. I find Luna's communicator connected to Prisma. She insists someone copied it.
La copia se hizo antes de que Luna nos c: The copy was made before Luna met us. The traitor is not at the garage: it is inside the system we use to talk.
Move the radio to a clean band.
Listen to Luna. End of Chapter III.
Abandonamos los telefonos. Para entrar e: We abandon our phones. To enter the tower we will use maps, radio signals and three physical keys. Each person carries only one part.
El plano tiene una sala borrada. Sara cr: The plan has an erased room. Sara thinks it holds the eastern node and controls the Horizonte program.
Interpret the marks on the plan.
Take the plans to the observatory.
Para copiar la llave oriental necesito s: To copy the eastern key I must maintain the connection from outside. Sara will open the terminal during her break.
La tercera llave esta completa. Pero Sar: The third key is complete. But Sara does not answer when we say goodbye. All we hear is a metal door.
Validate the three parts of the record.
No voy a dejarla ahi. Luna encuentra una: I won't leave her there. Luna finds a service entrance. Vera asks me to think before rushing in: without evidence, Sara risked everything for nothing.
Llegamos tarde. Sara dejo su chaqueta y: We are too late. Sara left her jacket and a note: They are taking me to Central. I still have the original.
Look for Sara in the erased room.
Prisma cierra las salidas del Centro. Ma: Prisma closes the Downtown exits. Mara suggests a fake transmission to move their equipment. She needs time and a convincing signal.
El desvio funciona. Tenemos una ventana: The diversion works. We have a window to evacuate the neighbourhoods before the wipe.
Atrae la persecucion lejos del hospital: Draw the pursuit away from the hospital and escape.
No todos pueden dejar sus casas. Luz org: Not everyone can leave home. Luz organises food and Luna prepares cars. I must connect the six meeting points.
Los puntos estan listos. Tiza pinta las: The meeting points are ready. Tiza paints the routes on the ground. This time the city can read its own exits.
Tenemos tres llaves y cientos de nombres: We have three keys and hundreds of names. To publish the evidence, we must reconstruct a file anyone can verify.
Por primera vez la historia esta complet: For the first time the story is complete. Cardenal receives the court notice and moves Horizonte forward to tonight.
Sort the records from the three nodes.
Decidimos actuar esta noche. Fin del cap: We decide to act tonight. End of Chapter IV.
La luz cae por sectores. No queda tiempo: The lights go out sector by sector. There is no time for a careful approach. Luna prepares the car, Mara opens the radio and Vera warns the neighbours.
El Centro queda conectado a la radio del: Downtown is connected to the neighbourhood radio. Even if they shut down the network, we can talk.
Meet Luna and check the car.
La radio recibe peticiones de ayuda y te: The radio receives calls for help and testimonies. Sara's voice is among them. She is inside the Central Server and can still guide us.
Sara revela el acceso trasero. Tambien n: Sara reveals the rear entrance. She warns us: destroying the server would erase the evidence. Copy it before stopping it.
Separate Sara's voice from the noise.
Take a battery to the South garden.
Los vecinos abren una ruta hacia el Cent: The neighbours open a route to Central.
El camino del Sur esta abierto, pero Pri: The southern route is open, but Prisma is watching it. The plan depends on arriving with Vera's disc intact.
Llegamos al acceso del Central. Dentro,: We reach the Central entrance. Inside, Horizonte has started erasing the oldest records.
Take the disc to the Central Server.
Sara responde detras de una puerta. Para: Sara answers behind a door. To open it I must rebuild the circuit Prisma dismantled. I hear her counting the time between each blackout.
Sara sale. Esta agotada, pero se niega a: Sara gets out. She is exhausted, but refuses to leave without copying the names still inside the machine.
Introduce la clave que Sara dejo dividid: Enter the code Sara split into clues.
Talk to Sara face to face.
La copia necesita una alimentacion estab: The copy needs stable power. If we fail, we must try again while the system keeps closing access points.
La copia termina. Miles de firmas vuelve: The copy finishes. Thousands of signatures have owners again. Cardenal flees the tower as Horizonte runs out of orders.
Isolate the copy from the wipe circuit.
Seal the backup with the final code.
La salida esta bloqueada. Luna llega des: The exit is blocked. Luna arrives from the south, but we must take the disc to the radio before they cut off the last antenna.
Mara conecta el disco. Tenemos las prueb: Mara connects the disc. We have the evidence and Sara is back. We still have to decide what to do with everything we found.
Lleva a Sara y el respaldo a Radio Lader: Take Sara and the backup to Radio Ladera.
Gather the group. End of Chapter V.
La caida de Prisma no devuelve automatic: Prisma's downfall does not automatically return the homes. Every family needs its documents. We can help rebuild them.
Los primeros expedientes vuelven a sus d: The first files return to their owners. Luz opens the market again, this time with a paper backup.
Entrega las primeras carpetas a Dona Luz: Deliver the first folders to Dona Luz.
Tiza quiere pintar los nombres de quiene: Tiza wants to paint the names of those who defended their neighbourhoods. Not as heroes: as neighbours who chose to stay together.
El nuevo mural no tapa el anterior. Lo r: The new mural does not cover the old one. It surrounds it. The first key is still there, so nobody forgets how it all began.
Take paint and sketches to the court.
Acompana el ritmo de la jornada del mura: Join the rhythm of the mural painting day.
Take copies of the mural to six neighbourhoods.
Look at the mural with Tiza.
Queda una copia de Horizonte en la anten: A copy of Horizonte remains at the eastern antenna. It no longer controls the city, but could be used again if someone finds it.
El ultimo respaldo queda bloqueado y doc: The last backup is locked and documented. Sara gives the keys to a network of neighbours so nobody holds them all at once.
Avoid the sensors that are still active.
Mara organiza un concierto abierto. No h: Mara organises an open concert. No guest list, no Prisma equipment. The city can hear itself again.
Luna baila por primera vez en semanas. S: Luna dances for the first time in weeks. Sara laughs. Vera turns off her phone. I stay a while without thinking about my next delivery.
Prepare the broadcast from the plaza.
Close the concert with the second track.
Tenemos pruebas publicas y datos privado: We have public evidence and the neighbours' private data. Vera suggests taking the file to court. Mara wants to publish a protected version for everyone too.
Nadie recuperara esas semanas. Pero pode: Nobody will get those weeks back. But we can decide how the story is told and who controls their data.
Escucha a Vera: un expediente verificabl: Listen to Vera: a verifiable file for the courts.
Escucha a Mara: una memoria publica que: Listen to Mara: a public record protecting the neighbours.
Separa los nombres privados de las prueb: Separate private names from public evidence.
Decide como compartir las pruebas desde: Choose how to share the evidence at the lookout.
La ciudad no se arreglo en una noche. Ha: The city was not fixed overnight. There is work, streets to explore and debts that won't fit in a file. But dawn no longer belongs to Prisma.
Sara vuelve al mirador. Luna me devuelve: Sara returns to the lookout. Luna gives me the car keys. Mara turns on the radio. Vera asks what I'll do now. I smile: first, a drive around the city.
Record the final track at Radio Ladera.
Conduce hasta el mirador para ver el ama: Drive to the lookout to see the sunrise.
